FN-SLVY988-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 103
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Economic Development
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 01/14/2026
Senate Bill 103 as introduced would establish the Alabama Construction Recruitment Institute
as a division within the Alabama Department of Workforce beginning October 1, 2026. This
could increase the administrative obligations of the Department by an undetermined amount
dependent upon the cost to provide the administrative services necessary for the Institute to
carry out its duties. However, any costs incurred would be offset by income accruing to the
Institute from construction craft industry fees collected for use by the Institute. For FY 2025,
total estimated funds available to the Institute were $3.8 million and estimated expenditures
were $1.79 million.
The provisions of this bill would provide for the continuance of the Alabama Construction
Recruitment Institute until October 1, 2030, pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law.
